tasks.defect: OrderService::canceledOrder cancels an order without restocking its items. A PENDING order's stock was decremented at placement and is never returned on cancellation, so inventory silently drifts down on every cancelled pending order.
tasks.why_strong: VERIFIED at the commit: canceledOrder is `if (!in_array($model->status,[NEW,PENDING])) throw ...; return $this->repo->canceledOrder($model);` with no restock. 271a9d0 'fix : stock in cancel' adds exactly `if($model->status == OrderStatusEnum::PENDING) $this->repo->restockItems($model);` and wraps the whole thing in a transaction.
expected_missing_context: app/Repositories/OrderRepository.php::restockItems — that a restock helper exists at all
where stock is decremented at placement

tasks.defect: ProductController::show eager-loads the relation 'category' (singular) and ProductResource emits `'category' => new CategoryResource($this->category)`, but Product declares a many-to-many `categories` relation — the model's own scope uses `whereHas('categories')`. The singular relation does not exist, so the load fails or yields null and the API never returns a product's categories.
tasks.why_strong: VERIFIED at the commit: `$product->load('category','media')` is introduced here. e4d92dd 'fix : product category relations' changes it to `load('categories','media')` and the resource to `CategoryResource::collection($this->categories)`.
expected_missing_context: app/Models/Product.php — which relation names actually exist

tasks.defect: The order-placement path resolves a delivery address to a city and proceeds, without checking whether the city, governorate or country is active. Orders can be placed to delivery areas the operator has switched off.
tasks.why_strong: VERIFIED: this commit introduces `$city = $this->addressRepo->getCity($request['address_id']);` with no active check. b0fabba 'fix : address deliver if no active' replaces it with a load of city/governorate/country and throws unless all three are active.
expected_missing_context: app/Models/City.php / Governorate — that an is_active column exists

tasks.defect: The order endpoints eager-load only `address` and `items.product`, while OrderResource renders the address's governorate and city and the assigned driver — so those are either N+1 lazy loads or null.
tasks.why_moderate: 72cd5a7 'fix : order resource' widens the load to `address.governorate`, `address.city`, `driver` and adds a DriverResource, which establishes the omission was unwanted. But a missing eager load is a performance or shape issue whose severity depends on the resource, and the fix message does not describe a failure. Not inflated to STRONG.
expected_missing_context: app/Http/Resources/OrderResource.php — what the resource actually renders

tasks.defect: The coupon API is a single-action `__invoke` controller with no `show`, so a coupon cannot be retrieved by model binding, and the validation path is entangled with the invoke handler.
tasks.why_moderate: 0b01ee7 'fix : coupon validation' splits it into `show(Coupon $coupon)` and `store(CouponRequest $request)`. That establishes the shape was wrong, but a single-action controller is a design choice as much as a defect. MODERATE.
